blockers.description: RESOLVED 2026-09-03. Fresh project, DB password, and service_role JWT all provided. Migrations applied, Phase 1 closed, and the auth flow verified end-to-end against the live DB (evidence/testnet/phase2-auth-e2e.log). Credentials live only in the gitignored .env and apps/worker/.dev.vars. For deploy, set them with `wrangler secret put`.

Real Nimiq Pay app on a physical phone is required for SDK init, device identifier prompt, account list, sign, sendBasicTransactionWithData, and all real-device acceptance gates (PRD section 39.8). Blocks the Phase 2 gate. Non-device Phase 2 work (auth routes, backend tx verifier) can proceed without it.
Real NIM on MainAlbatross is required to fund the flagship Global Relay baton and run the production smoke relay.

openVerificationItems: RESOLVED (D-006): RPC network identity for rpc.nimiqwatch.com (MainAlbatross) and rpc.testnet.nimiqwatch.com (TestAlbatross), confirmed by live block-height cross-referencing in both directions.
OPEN: Nimiq Pay deep-link path/query passthrough for /invite/<token> style URLs - still to test empirically in Phase 2.

PARTIALLY RESOLVED: Nimiq message-signing byte layout cross-checked against a golden vector from the real @nimiq/core build (evidence/testnet/phase2-nimiq-signature-vector.md). Still open: confirming the Mini App SDK sign() path on a real physical device follows the same construction end to end.
OPEN (Phase 9): every public Supabase table has RLS enabled with no policies (service_role-only). Explicit RLS policy design is required before any direct browser->Supabase access.
